blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — The Camarines Sur government activated a 30-day mobilization program to prepare communities and farms for a potentially very strong El Niño that could cause water shortages and threaten agricultural production through the first half of 2027. On Sunday, Gov. Luis Raymund “Lray” Villafuerte Jr. issued Executive Order No. 30, series of 2026, creating the CamSur El Niño Mobilization and Water Security Program to identify vulnerable communities, secure alternative water supplies, and align farming activities with available irrigation resources. “We do not have to wait for a severe drought to arrive, for our communities to lose access to water, […]... Keep on reading: Camarines Sur activates water security program ahead of El Niño
